name: Aster Staked USDF
oneLiner: asUSDF is the staked, NAV-accreting wrapper of Aster's USDF, capturing yield from underlying delta-neutral and funding-fee strategies on Binance/MirrorX.
collateral: USDF deposited into the Aster Earn asToken wrapper; upstream USDF is backed by USDT held through Ceffu and delta-neutral Binance / MirrorX strategies.
pegMechanism: Users stake USDF to mint asUSDF. asUSDF APY is reflected in NAV from delta-neutral and funding-fee strategies; withdrawals return USDF after Aster's documented T+1 hour / two-hour waiting period with no mint or withdrawal fee.

oracleRisk.summary: asUSDF is a NAV-accreting staking wrapper minted from deposited USDF and withdrawn back to USDF through Aster's queue, not a borrower debt market with oracle-triggered collateral liquidation.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: Aster documents asUSDF as the yield-bearing wrapper received by staking USDF. Minting and withdrawal change wrapper shares and return the upstream USDF asset; asUSDF does not create collateralized borrower positions or expose collateral-health liquidation branches of its own.

oracleRisk.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: asUSDF resolves to Upstream because it is a staked wrapper of USDF and inherits the parent asset's custody, reserve, and issuer-control exposure. The holder-facing asUSDF contract is role-controlled and pausable, with mint/burn authority assigned to privileged roles.

mintAuthority.summary: asUSDF is the savings-passthrough staked wrapper of Aster USDF; shares are minted when USDF is staked and do not create base USDF supply, so its mint authority is inherited from USDF (usdf-astherus).

controls.label: Aster Earn asUSDF wrapper token
controls.capDescription: asUSDF has a privileged mint(address,uint256) function gated by MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE (0x144dc672...). At BSC block 103632926, that role is held by contract 0xdB57a53C428a9faFcbFefFB6dd80d0f427543695 (the Aster staking/earn module). DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder is not identified.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103632926: mint(address,uint256) call reverted with AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount(caller, 0x144dc67236c5b8b129f92a31bb5cba2a9c107df2d9bcedef0515ca3f60ecb794) — confirming a privileged mint path gated by MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE. hasRole(MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE, 0xdB57a53C428a9faFcbFefFB6dd80d0f427543695) = true; that address is a contract (1712 bytes). DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder not found among known Aster contract addresses from docs. Contract has DELEGATECALL opcode (proxy) but EIP-1967 storage slots are zero; custom proxy pattern — upgrade admin unconfirmable.

controls.label: Aster MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE holder (staking module)
controls.evidence: hasRole(0x144dc672..., 0xdB57a5...) = true at BSC block 103632926. Contract bytecode len=1712 bytes; owner() and name() revert. Identity not conclusively verified but context (Aster earn module list) suggests it is the Aster staking/earn contract that authorizes shares against deposited USDF.

controls.label: Inherited USDF (Astherus) MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE mint path
controls.evidence: Underlying USDF supply is created via an AccessControl MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE with an owner/default-admin path (permissioned-minter, partially-bounded-admin); this wrapper holds USDF and inherits that base mint authority.

review.evidence: asUSDF (variantOf usdf-astherus, variantKind savings-passthrough) has a confirmed privileged mint path (MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE=0x144dc672...) on the wrapper itself, held by contract 0xdB57a5. The DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder is unknown. The wrapper also uses a custom proxy pattern (DELEGATECALL in bytecode, EIP-1967 slots empty), so upgrade admin is unconfirmable.
